def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows)]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]
    colors = {v for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows for v in grid[r] if v != sep}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r not in sep_rows))
    marker = next(v for v in colors if v != background)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce)) >= 2 else background
             for cs, ce in zip(col_starts, col_ends)]
            for rs, re in zip(row_starts, row_ends)]
